Allan — good to have you here, and given what you're doing with Hiizzy, "different" is probably the honest thing to press me on. The short version: I work across strategy, design and development, which is rare in one person, and I've spent 25 years in the messy middle of getting products actually shipped and used.

Where that shows: I've done proptech from a founder's angle before — I rebranded Urban.co.uk ahead of their pre-seed raise — and I've spent years untangling genuinely complex, multi-party regulatory products at Vaiie, where the whole challenge was making layered ownership and compliance legible to real people. That's the kind of "sits between agents, portals and conveyancers" complexity you're wrestling with.
